question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

The king's coronation ceremony was a grand affair, with all the nobles and dignitaries dressed in their finest __**insignia of royalty**.__
solution:
The correct answer is **"regalia."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Regalia"** refers to the distinctive clothing and accessories worn by someone in a position of authority or honor, such as a monarch or a member of a fraternal organization, the emblems or insignia of royalty, especially the crown, sceptre, and other ornaments used at a coronation. (अधिकार या सम्मान की स्थिति में किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा पहने जाने वाले विशिष्ट कपड़े और सहायक उपकरण, जैसे कि एक राजा या किसी भाईचारे के संगठन का सदस्य, राजघराने के प्रतीक या चिन्ह, विशेष रूप से मुकुट, राजदंड और राज्याभिषेक के समय उपयोग किए जाने वाले अन्य आभूषण)

 
 
• **Example**: *The biker was dressed in full **regalia**__, with shiny black leather and lots of chains.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The word **"ornaments"** refers to decorative items that are used to enhance the appearance of something, such as a Christmas tree or a piece of jewelry. (अलंकार, सजावटी वस्‍तु (गहना आदि))
 
• **"Regals"** refers to something that is royal or regal in nature. (बहुत शानदार (मानो राजा या रानी के लायक़); राजोचित, राजसी, शाही)
 
• **"Spectres"** refers to ghostly apparitions or haunting visions. (कोई आगामी संकट (जिसकी लोगों को आशंका हो))
